messages:
Elena: Need a short thread to lock customer-facing follow-ups for the Apr 22 outage. Deliverables: 1) statuspage 1-2 line blurb, 2) 72h public summary, 3) enterprise outreach + briefing offer, 4) clear RCA request flow + NDA note. Assign owners and firm deadlines.

Varun: I can take the statuspage blurb. Will keep it factual and non-technical. Drafting now.

Marta: I'll own the 72h public summary (public audience). ETA 2024-04-26 17:00 PT so Legal can redline.

Jules: Enterprise outreach and briefing templates owned. I'll prepare CS scripts and an opt-in private briefing offer for materially impacted accounts. ETA 2024-04-26 COB.

Mateo: I'll own the recurrence follow-up (KV cache eviction pattern) and open a mitigation task. ETA mitigation proposal 2024-05-06.

Varun: Statuspage draft: 
`Status: Partial service disruption — Resolved. Between 03:12 and 03:42 UTC some requests to the embeddings endpoint experienced elevated latency and errors for a subset of requests. We mitigated impact and service is operating normally. A redacted summary will be posted within 72 hours.`

LegalBot: Suggest swapping "errors" -> "errors for some requests" and add a short RCA-access sentence: "Customers who experienced material impact may request a detailed RCA via Support; sensitive information may be shared under NDA at Legal's discretion." Avoid internal incident IDs in public copy.

Varun: Updated per LegalBot and added: "To request a detailed RCA, contact Support (do not reference internal incident IDs)." Pushing to staging once Marta confirms 72h hooks.

Marta: 72h public summary outline saved: timeline, impact by customer bucket, mitigation steps, recurrence note, next steps, and how to request RCA. I'll flag redaction candidates for Legal.

Jules: Enterprise email template will include: 1) brief summary, 2) account impact check, 3) private briefing offer with suggested dates, 4) CS script and escalation path. Will include link to Support flow instead of IDs.

Mateo: Opening follow-up task for recurrence and monitoring improvements. Will propose short-term mitigations and longer-term fixes by 2024-05-06.

OpsBot: Task TASK-9402 created and assigned to Mateo: "investigate-kv-cache-evictions". Link: https://tracker.redwood.example/TASK-9402

Elena: Action list for the tracker (please confirm):
- Statuspage copy: Varun -> staging 2024-04-25 17:30 PT, publish 2024-04-25 18:00 PT
- 72h public summary: Marta -> 2024-04-26 17:00 PT
- Enterprise outreach & briefings: Jules -> 2024-04-26 COB
- RCA request flow + NDA blurb: LegalBot -> signoff 2024-04-28
- Recurrence mitigation plan: Mateo/Platform SRE -> proposal 2024-05-06

Marta: Confirmed. I'll loop Legal on redactions by EOD today.

LegalBot: Received. I'll review the 72h draft and the RCA request wording; expect feedback by 2024-04-28. Will prepare NDA template if needed.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled for 1901154600 (tomorrow 10:30 PT) for final copy sign-off.
